race.comment: WINNING ALL ROUND (1) had a bit on his rivals when resuming last time out over 1350m at Strathalbyn. Is lightly raced and has plenty of scope for improvement. Murphy retains the mount and looms as a serious contender again. CUTE GIRL (2) was also an impressive maiden winner last time out, justifying the short quote over the mile at Warracknabeal. Sparingly raced and has more to offer. MRS HARRIS (3) returns and makes her stable debut for the Page camp. Showed good signs last prep and boasts peaks that can measure up. The 4kg claim gets her in a treat at the weights too. ON THE MAP (6) lacks early speed but can make her presence felt late if the pace is genuine.
